title: NOX METALS vs Speedy Metals for Cut-to-Size Aluminum Plate
summary: Speedy Metals publishes a plus or minus 0.030 inch production sawing tolerance and a site-wide lead time estimate. NOX METALS goes deeper on thick and aerospace plate with a committed per-line ship date. Where each one wins.
body_markdown:
### What is Speedy Metals cut tolerance?


Speedy Metals states plus or minus 0.030 inch on production sawing orders. That is the tightest publicly published saw tolerance among the online aluminum sellers we checked in August 2026.


### What is Speedy Metals lead time?


They post a site-wide estimate of roughly 2 to 3 business days, with burn plate material called out separately at 10 to 15 days. It is an average across the catalog rather than a date computed for your order, so a thick or unusual cut can run longer.


### Does Speedy Metals sell 7050 aluminum plate?


Not as far as we can determine from their public catalog. They carry 7075 along with 2011, 2024, 3003, 5052, 6061 and 6063. For 7050-T7451 to AMS 4050 you need a supplier that stocks aerospace plate.


### Can I pick up an order from Speedy Metals?


Yes, but only at their Wisconsin facilities in New Berlin and Appleton for website orders. Everything else ships freight.


### Which is better for a defense contract?


If your purchase order carries a DFARS 252.225-7009 flow-down you need melt-source documentation, and that is not something Speedy publicly offers. We ship mill certs with heat numbers and lot traceability on every order and stock DFARS-compliant and domestic-melt material across 6061, 7075 and 7050.
